## GameHooks  (type-only)
interface GameHooks {
    update?(dt: number): void;
    frame?(dt: number): void;
    beforeRender?(time: Time): void;
    afterRender?(time: Time): void;
    hide?(reason: HideReason): void;
    show?(reason: ShowReason): void;
    lifecycle?(state: HostLifecycleState): void;
    deviceLost?(info: GPUDeviceLostInfo): void;
}

interface KitCore {

## KitGame  (type-only)
type KitGame<K extends KitOptions> = KitCtx<SaveOf<K>> & FieldsOf<K, 'post'> & FieldsOf<K, 'particles'> & FieldsOf<K, 'ui'> & FieldsOf<K, 'audio'> & FieldsOf<K, 'input'> & FieldsOf<K, 'xr'> & (K extends {
    readonly loop: {
        readonly frames: 'external';
    };
} ? KitExternalFrame : unknown);

## KitOptions  (type-only)
interface KitOptions<S extends FlushableSave | null = FlushableSave | null> {
    root?: HTMLElement;
    gpu?: GpuContext;
    dom?: boolean;
    host?: Host;
    clock?: TickClock;
    title?: string;
    design?: {
        width: number;
        height: number;
    };
    surface?: Omit<SurfaceOptions, 'logicalWidth' | 'logicalHeight'>;
    aux?: SceneTargetAux;
    onGpuReady?(gpu: GpuContext): void;
    blockBrowserZoom?: boolean;
    forceUnsupported?: boolean;
    save?(host: Host): S;
    crash?: boolean | CrashOptions;
    loop?: KitLoopOptions;
    post?: KitService<object>;
    particles?: KitService<object, KitStepPart<object>>;
    ui?: KitService<{
        readonly ui: Overlay;
    }>;
    audio?: KitService<{
        readonly audio: AudioEngine;
    }>;
    input?: KitService<{
        readonly pointers: PointerRouter<unknown>;
    }, KitInputPart>;
    xr?: KitService<{
        readonly xr: XrControl;
    }, KitXrPart>;
}
